evidence.focus: Fresh-score IC 0.054 (t 9.8, 2007-2026, verified); top-decile excess ~+10.5pp/yr gross before costs at 48%/mo turnover; small/micro-heavy (17 large, 31 mid at Aug-2026); costs plausibly halve the excess. Stale scores predict nothing (-0.005). Size-checked on a dynamic top-200 universe (verified): the ranking skill survives (IC 0.051; partial IC after size+momentum controls 0.040) but ~1/3 of the raw spread was small-cap membership -- net long-only vs a top-200 benchmark ~5-6pp/yr. Cadence: quarterly for the broad small/micro-heavy list; monthly viable for a liquid top-200 sub-list at 20-30bps costs. Recent era runs at ~half strength (2019-22 IC ~0.03) -- alive, not guaranteed.
